# BooyahEsports — Official Free Fire Tournament Platform & APK

> BooyahEsports (booyahesports.com) is the leading esports tournament mobile app and web platform for Free Fire battle royale players. It offers automated custom rooms, anti-cheat protection, live leaderboard tracking, and instant cash prize withdrawals via UPI and Paytm.

## Core Services & Features
- **Official APK Download**: Free & safe direct download of BooyahEsports APK (Version 1.109.1, Size ~705MB, Android 5.0+).
- **Free Fire Tournaments**: Daily Solo, Duo, Squad, and Clash Squad custom matches.
- **Automated Custom Rooms**: Room ID and Password auto-delivered 15 minutes before match start.
- **Anti-Cheat & Fair Play**: Server-side anti-cheat verification guaranteeing anti-ban compliance.
- **Instant Rewards & Payouts**: Guaranteed prize cash and Free Fire Diamonds sent straight to local wallets/UPI.
